Manufacturing PMI® at 54.6%; August 2026 ISM® Manufacturing PMI® Report

News provided by

Institute for Supply Management

Sep 01, 2026, 10:00 ET

The Manufacturing PMI® registered 54.6 percent in August, 1 percentage point below the July figure of 55.6 percent.

The next ISM® Manufacturing PMI® Report featuring September 2026 data will be released at 10:00 a.m. ET on Thursday, October 1, 2026.

SOURCE Institute for Supply Management
